chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man and a woman praying together in a house, with the woman on the right side of the man, level with him. He said: “No, not unless there is between them a handspan, or a cubit, or something similar.”

key_terms.بَيْتٍ: a house or indoor place of prayer
key_terms.بِحِذَائِهِ: level with him; directly alongside him
key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit as a measure of separation
key_terms.شِبْرٌ: a handspan as a measure of separation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man and a woman praying side by side in the same room?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the arrangement of a man and a woman when they perform salat together in the same place. It states that if the woman stands level with the man on his right side, this is not permitted unless a separating distance such as a handspan, a cubit, or something similar exists between them.
